note: Replaces editorial copy that was written for a release record rather than for a reader. The thirteen EGO entries replace generated lists that recited licence numbers the page already shows. The fifteen CASINO-REAL-CATALOG-02/03 entries replace internal release vocabulary — 'the Superfly set', 'a disabled Preview card', 'creative geography', 'the governed corpus' — which buried facts a player actually needs, notably 21 Prive's withdrawal-complaint history, Slotnite's payout-delay complaints and Betsson's Swedish anti-money-laundering sanction. Every statement is traceable to the checksum-verified bundles and release records already in data/. Nothing here grants commercial or referral authority.

entries.description: AHTI Games is SkillOnNet's Nordic brand, launched in 2019 and built around fast bank-ID banking rather than card deposits. In Sweden that means Trustly and BankID; in Great Britain the cashier is conventional cards, PayPal, Apple Pay and instant bank transfer. The catalogue is the standard SkillOnNet shelf — Evolution for live tables, NetEnt, Play'n GO, Pragmatic Play, Playtech, Red Tiger, Push Gaming, Relax Gaming, Blueprint and Games Global for slots — spread across slots, jackpots, Megaways, live casino, blackjack, roulette and table games. What separates it from its sister brands is the ongoing tournament and VIP structure rather than the game list. Profiles are published for Austria, Denmark, Great Britain and Sweden; the licence record runs through the UK Gambling Commission and Spelinspektionen, with the Malta B2C licence covering the .com brand.

entries.description: BacanaPlay is SkillOnNet's Portuguese-first casino, live since 2019/20 and licensed by SRIJ in Portugal, which puts it in a different category from the operator's international brands: the cashier is built on MB WAY and Multibanco, the site is Portuguese-language first, and the VIB loyalty club is aimed at that market. It also runs in Brazil on a .bet.br domain. Around 2,200 games come from nine studios, including MGA Games — a Spanish and Portuguese specialist that does not appear on the operator's Nordic brands — alongside Evolution, Playtech, Pragmatic Play, NetEnt and Play'n GO. Profiles are published for Portugal, Brazil, Austria, Denmark, Great Britain and Sweden. Outside Portugal the picture thins considerably: the UK site is a conventional card-and-PayPal cashier under the Gambling Commission licence, and the other markets run under the Malta licence.

Profiles are published for Austria, Canada, Denmark, Great Britain and Sweden. The UK site (redkings.com) is active on the Gambling Commission register under Skill On Net Limited; the other language variants run under the operator's Malta licence. The cashier we have on record is the UK one — Visa and Mastercard debit, PayPal, Apple Pay and instant bank transfer.

The brand is heavily TV-advertised in Germany. Advertising spend is not evidence about the product, and we have scored it on neither.
entries.description: DrückGlück is SkillOnNet's German-facing online Spielothek, running since 2015 and holding a GGL virtual-slots permit for drueckglueck.de since 29 December 2022 — which makes it one of the few brands in this group with a live German permit rather than an offshore licence. That permit also brings Germany's player-protection regime with it: LUGAS and OASIS checks at registration and a €1,000 monthly deposit limit shared across all German-licensed operators. The German slot studios reflect the market — Merkur, Novomatic and Gamomat alongside Playtech, Pragmatic Play, Evolution, NetEnt and Play'n GO — and the cashier carries German rails including paysafecard, Sofort/Klarna and Banküberweisung. Profiles are published for Germany, Denmark, Great Britain and Sweden; the .com and .co.uk domains are active on the UK register, and the Nordic-language variants run under the Malta licence.

Danish players, who get a dedicated locally licensed site at eucasino.dk rather than a translated international one.
Multilingual and multi-currency players — 20+ language versions and the widest currency list of any brand here.

entries.description: EUcasino is the longest-running brand in SkillOnNet's stable, live since 2009, and the widest by language and currency: 20-plus language versions, a VIP club, and slots, live casino and table games from the operator's usual ten studios. Denmark is the one market with a dedicated local site — eucasino.dk holds its own Danish licence and uses MitID for identification — while the .com and .co.uk domains are active on the UK register and the rest run under the Malta licence. The name does more work than the footprint justifies: we publish profiles for Austria, Canada, Denmark, Great Britain and Sweden, and of the sixteen market profiles on record only those five are available. A language version is not a licence, and this brand is a clear case of the difference.

Readers who prefer a focused shelf to an exhaustive one.

The supplier list is the operator's standard ten: Playtech, Pragmatic Play, Evolution, NetEnt, Play'n GO, Red Tiger, Push Gaming, Relax Gaming, Blueprint Gaming and Games Global. Profiles are published for Austria, Canada, Denmark, Great Britain and Sweden, with nine language variants in total. jackpotstar.com is active on the UK register under Skill On Net Limited; other variants run under the Malta licence. If you want blackjack or roulette, this is the wrong brand in the group — several of its siblings carry both.

entries.description: MegawaysCasino is the officially Megaways-branded casino, operated by SkillOnNet and launched in the UK before an international rollout under the Malta licence. Big Time Gaming — who invented the Megaways mechanic — supplies directly, alongside Blueprint Gaming, Pragmatic Play, Playtech, Red Tiger and Evolution for live tables. Four categories are on record: Megaways, slots, jackpots and live casino. This is the smallest catalogue of any brand in this group, which is the point of the brand but also the main reason its Editor Score sits at the bottom of the set: our score rewards breadth of verified record, and a deliberately narrow shelf scores as a narrow shelf. Great Britain is the only market with a published profile, served by the usual UK cashier of debit cards, PayPal, Apple Pay and instant bank transfer.

bestFor: Anyone who has been burned by wagering requirements — PlayOJO applies none to any promotion, which is the brand's whole proposition.
Players who want money back on losing bets as a standing rule rather than an occasional promotion: OJOplus pays on every bet.
Players in a regulated market — it holds local licences in Great Britain, Sweden, Spain, Denmark and Ontario rather than serving them from offshore.
thingsToKnow: No wagering does not mean no terms. Game weighting, maximum bets and eligibility still apply, and you should read the current terms in your own market.
The Ontario registration is recorded as reported only; we have not read it against the AGCO register, and it does not count toward the trust component of the score.
The only offer on record is a UK free-spins offer, and it is not published as active.
entries.description: PlayOJO is SkillOnNet's flagship, live since March 2017, and the one brand in this group with a genuine structural difference rather than a thematic one: it applies no wagering requirements to any promotion, and OJOplus returns money on every bet placed, win or lose. That is unusual enough to be the reason to consider it. It is also the most widely licensed brand here, with local licences in Great Britain, Sweden, Spain, Denmark and Ontario, which is why it carries the highest trust component in this set. The catalogue is the broadest of the SkillOnNet brands — twelve studios including Big Time Gaming and Yggdrasil alongside the usual ten — across slots, live casino, bingo, jackpots, Megaways, blackjack, roulette and table games. Profiles are published for Austria, Canada, Denmark, Spain, Great Britain, Mexico and Sweden. Withdrawal timing is the weak spot in the record: outside the UK's 1–3 working days, method-specific timing is not verified in any market.

entries.description: PlayOJO Bingo is the bingo side of PlayOJO, operated by Skill On Net Limited under a UK Gambling Commission Bingo Remote licence held since February 2020. It runs 90-ball and 75-ball rooms with Slingo and side games, under the same no-wagering rules as the main PlayOJO site — which is the reason to choose it over a general casino's bingo tab. The record is correspondingly small: Playtech, Pragmatic Play and Slingo supply it, and bingo, Slingo and slots are the three categories on file. Great Britain is the only market with a published profile, served by debit cards, PayPal, Apple Pay and instant bank transfer. Its Editor Score is the lowest in this group, which reflects the breadth of the verified record rather than a judgement on the bingo itself.

entries.description: PlayUZU is SkillOnNet's Spanish-language casino and the sister brand to PlayOJO, sharing its central idea: no wagering requirements, and UZUplus money-back on every bet. It has been licensed in Spain by DGOJ since 2020 and also runs in Mexico, Peru, Buenos Aires City and Brazil. The catalogue runs from roughly 2,500 to 4,300 titles depending on market, from the operator's usual ten studios, and includes live casino, blackjack, roulette, jackpots and Megaways. The Spanish cashier carries Bizum alongside cards and PayPal. The licensing record is uneven and worth reading carefully: Spain is verified against the DGOJ register, while the entities behind the Mexican, Peruvian, Argentine and Brazilian sites are named in our record only as unverified. Profiles are published for Austria, Brazil, Denmark, Spain, Mexico and Peru.

entries.description: Regency Casino Online is the digital arm of Regency Entertainment S.A., which has operated the Mont Parnes and Thessaloniki casinos for around three decades — so unlike every other brand in this group it comes from a land-based operator rather than a purely online one. It launched with SkillOnNet under a Greek HGC Type 2 licence, carrying 3,000+ games and live casino with Greek-speaking dealers, which is the practical reason for a Greek player to choose it. Eight studios supply it, including Evolution, Playtech, Pragmatic Play, NetEnt and Play'n GO. The payments picture in Greece has a real gap: Skrill, Neteller and Revolut are not supported, leaving cards and bank transfer. Profiles are published for Denmark, Great Britain and Greece. The UK presence is a white-label entry on the Gambling Commission register under Skill On Net Limited, with Regency Entertainment as brand owner — worth knowing if you are checking the register yourself.

entries.description: SlotsMagic has been running since 2014 and is the broadest catalogue in this group by a wide margin: 25 studios on record against the eight to twelve its sister brands carry. The list goes well past the usual names — Hacksaw Gaming, Peter & Sons, Octoplay, Amusnet, Lightning Box, Eyecon, Bragg, Playson, Inspired, Light & Wonder, iSoftBet and Slingo alongside Playtech, Pragmatic Play, Evolution, NetEnt and Games Global — across slots, Megaways, jackpots, live casino and table games. Native iOS and Android apps and 24/7 support are on record, both unusual in this set. Profiles are published for Austria, Canada, Denmark, Great Britain and Sweden. The .com and .co.uk domains are active on the UK register; Ontario is recorded as live but the registration has not been read against the AGCO register, and the 20 language variants run under the Malta licence.

bestFor: Swedish players who want to deposit and play without creating an account — this is a Pay N Play casino, so BankID through Trustly or Zimpler is the whole registration.
Players who want withdrawals back to the same bank account they deposited from, without a separate verification step.
Players who value getting started quickly over collecting a welcome package.
thingsToKnow: Pay N Play is a Swedish and Finnish mechanism. In Great Britain the cashier is conventional — debit cards, PayPal, Apple Pay and instant bank transfer — so the brand's main selling point does not apply there.
The Great Britain welcome asks 60x wagering on free-spin winnings — six times what its sister brands ask for the same kind of offer. That single number is the reason to read it twice.
Swedish Trustly withdrawals are reported as fast; the only timing we could verify is the UK record of 1–3 working days after approval.
entries.description: TurboNino is SkillOnNet's Pay N Play casino, live since 2021 and built around a single idea: you deposit through Trustly or Zimpler using bank ID, and that deposit is your registration. There is no sign-up form and no separate verification step, and withdrawals return to the account you paid from. That works in Sweden, where Trustly and Zimpler are both on the cashier under the Spelinspektionen licence. It does not work everywhere: in Great Britain the site runs a conventional cashier under the Gambling Commission licence, and the brand's defining feature is simply absent. Germany has its own GGL virtual-slots permit for turbonino.de. Eight studios supply the games — Playtech, Pragmatic Play, Evolution, NetEnt, Play'n GO, Red Tiger, Blueprint Gaming and Games Global — across slots, jackpots, Megaways, live casino, blackjack, roulette and table games. Profiles are published for Germany, Denmark, Great Britain and Sweden. Great Britain does carry a welcome offer — 100 free spins on Thor the Trials of Asgard — but at 60x wagering on the winnings, six times what the sister brands ask.

Readers comparing the largest bonus headline among the White Hat Gaming brands we cover.
Players who want a UK-licensed site with a long operating history behind it.

A big headline number is not a good offer by itself. The wagering requirement and maximum cash-out decide what it is worth, and those are what to compare.
Exact payment and withdrawal facts are still partial in our record, so the cashier detail here is thinner than on its sister brands.
entries.description: 21 Prive is a White Hat Gaming brand running since 2014, licensed by the UK Gambling Commission and published for Great Britain, Ireland and Malta. On paper it is the strongest of the White Hat brands we cover for cashier breadth — 14 payment methods and 16 game providers — and it carries the largest bonus headline of the group. The reason to slow down is its record on withdrawals: complaints about delayed payouts appear in its history, which is why its Editor Score sits below siblings with thinner catalogues. That history is a signal to investigate rather than a verdict, and it may well have been fixed, but it is the thing to verify before you deposit rather than after you try to withdraw.

Multilingual Baltic players who want the site and support in a local language.

The Latvian welcome offer's mechanics are incomplete on our side — read the current terms on the site before opting in.
Only Estonia and Latvia are profiled. Betsafe operates in more markets, and nothing here describes those.
entries.description: Betsafe has been running since 2006 and is one of the older names in this catalogue. We profile it for Estonia and Latvia, where it holds licences from the Estonian Tax and Customs Board and the Latvian Lotteries and Gambling Supervision Inspection — national regulators, not an offshore licence covering the region from a distance. The catalogue is broad, with 13 providers and 7 payment methods on record across slots, live casino and table games. Two gaps are worth naming: we have not established which payment methods the Estonian site offers, and the Latvian welcome offer's mechanics are only partly recorded. The operating company differs by market — Triogames OU in Estonia, SIA Latsson Licensing in Latvia — which is normal for locally licensed brands and is why no single corporate operator is listed.

bestFor: Players who want one of the oldest operators in the industry — Betsson dates to 1963.
Players in Peru or Sweden, the two markets where our local evidence is strongest.
Players who want local payment rails rather than international cards: 22 methods are on record.
thingsToKnow: Sweden's regulator warned Betsson Nordic Ltd and fined it SEK 6.5 million for serious anti-money-laundering failings. A licence is not a clean bill of health, and this is the clearest example in our catalogue.
The current welcome offer's mechanics are incomplete in our record for both Peru and Sweden, so the headline you see on the site is not one we have checked.
No game provider list is recorded for this brand, which is unusual here and means the catalogue depth is unverified on our side.
entries.description: Betsson traces back to 1963, which makes it by some distance the oldest operator in this catalogue, and it runs across seven markets we profile including Brazil, Colombia, Denmark, Spain, Mexico, Peru and Sweden. Its strength is local depth: 22 payment methods on record and national licences from MINCETUR in Peru and Spelinspektionen in Sweden. Its published record also contains the most serious regulatory finding we hold on any brand here. Spelinspektionen warned Betsson Nordic Ltd and imposed a SEK 6.5 million sanction for serious anti-money-laundering failings. We publish that alongside the licence rather than behind it, because a current licence and a clean compliance record are not the same thing, and a player deciding where to put money deserves both facts. Operating entities differ by market, so no single corporate operator is listed.

Players comparing a mid-sized welcome package rather than a headline-chasing one.

Exact product facts per market are only partly recorded, so the profile is thinner than the licence record suggests.
Which countries it actually serves beyond the stored Great Britain profile is unresolved on our side.
entries.description: Diamond7 is a White Hat Gaming brand live since 2015, holding a UK Gambling Commission licence and published for Great Britain, Ireland and Malta. It is the plainest of the White Hat brands we cover, and that is its character rather than a flaw: a slots-led casino with 10 providers and 10 payment methods, without the bingo rooms, jackpot rails or live-dealer depth some of its siblings carry. If you want a straightforward slot site from a licensed operator with ten years behind it, that is what this is. If you are comparing catalogue size, Hello Casino and 21 Prive sit on the same platform with noticeably more on the shelf.

Players comparing game categories rather than cashier detail — that is where this record is strongest.

Great Britain is the only market profiled. Nothing here describes it anywhere else.
No welcome offer is on record, so whatever the site shows you is unchecked by us.
entries.description: DragonBet is a UK-focused operator run by DragonBet Ltd, a company registered in the United Kingdom (number 15718764), with an active Gambling Commission record — which makes it one of the few genuinely British operators in this catalogue rather than an international brand holding a UK licence. Its strength in our record is the game side: eight categories on file including slots, live casino, table games, jackpots and virtual sports, alongside named providers. Its weakness is everything to do with money. We hold no payment method, no withdrawal timing and no offer for it, which is why it sits low on the score despite a clean licence record. Great Britain is the only market we profile.

Players who want a UK-licensed brand with a long run behind it — live since 2013.

Exact payment and withdrawal facts per market remain incomplete, so cashier timing is unverified.
It runs on the same White Hat Gaming platform as five other brands we cover, so the games are largely the same shelf under different dressing.
entries.description: G'day Casino is a White Hat Gaming brand running since 2013, licensed by the UK Gambling Commission and published for Great Britain, Ireland and Malta. The Australian styling is the brand's distinguishing feature and is worth being clear about: it is theming, not geography, and this is not an Australian-licensed operator. Underneath, it is the same White Hat platform as Hello Casino, Diamond7, Skol, Slotnite and 21 Prive, with 11 providers and 12 payment methods on record — a middling catalogue with above-average cashier choice for this group. Exact withdrawal timing per market is not established on our side.

Eleven promotions are recorded for this brand and none of them carries a verification date or a link to its terms, which is why none is published.
entries.description: GoldenPlay is a 2025 launch in the NetoPartners / Anakatech portfolio, combining casino and sportsbook under one brand across 22 markets — by far the widest footprint in this catalogue. Partner material lists 950+ games, seven product languages, and suppliers including Pragmatic Play, NetEnt, Evolution, Play'n GO and Spinoro, across slots, live casino, table games, instant-win, scratchcard and crash titles. Crypto is supported alongside cards, e-wallets and vouchers. Two things should temper the breadth. Its licence is from the Tobique Gaming Commission, an offshore B2C licence, and it is not a national licence in the markets it serves — so in most of those 22 countries no local regulator supervises this operator or can help you in a dispute. And launched in 2025, it has no operating history to speak of: everything you can judge it on is what the operator says about itself.

Exact country availability beyond the stored Great Britain profile is not established on our side.
The offer we hold is a rest-of-world offer; what you see in your own market may differ.
entries.description: Hello Casino has run since 2014 on the White Hat Gaming platform, licensed by the UK Gambling Commission and published for Great Britain, Ireland and Malta. Of the six White Hat brands in this catalogue it carries the deepest shelf — 17 providers including Games Global, NetEnt, Evolution, Betsoft, Big Time Gaming and Blueprint — with 12 payment methods and a welcome offer whose mechanics are unusually completely recorded: 100% to EUR 300 plus 100 spins, 35x wagering, EUR 20 minimum deposit, EUR 5 maximum bet. That completeness is the reason to consider it. The reason to hesitate is payout speed: three days or more is the timing on record, the slowest on this platform, and several of its siblings settle in one to two.

Some payment limits in our record come from partner material rather than the operator's own published terms.
entries.description: Inkabet is a Peruvian casino operated by Lucky Torito SAC under MINCETUR authorisation, running since 2012 — locally licensed rather than an international brand taking Peruvian players from offshore, which is the distinction that matters most in this market. It holds the strongest single-market record in this catalogue: current authorisations on file, 11 payment methods in soles, 12 providers including Evolution, Playtech, Pragmatic Play, Play'n GO, Microgaming and Greentube, and a welcome offer with complete mechanics — 100% to PEN 500 plus 100 spins at 30x with a PEN 20 minimum. Responsible-gambling controls are recorded locally rather than assumed from a group policy. Peru is the only market profiled, and nothing here describes the brand elsewhere.

Players who want casino and poker from one operator, which is unusual in this catalogue.
Players who want a Spelinspektionen-licensed site: this is a Swedish licence, not an offshore one.
thingsToKnow: The welcome offer's mechanics are incomplete in our record — we know the headline but not the wagering or the deposit minimum.

There is generic Malta licence material circulating for this brand that conflicts with the Swedish profile. We exclude it rather than reconcile it, so treat any MGA claim you see elsewhere with caution.
Only Denmark and Sweden are profiled. NordicBet operates more widely and nothing here covers that.
entries.description: NordicBet has run since 2002 and is a Nordic specialist rather than an international brand with a Nordic skin: the Swedish site holds a Spelinspektionen licence through NGG Nordic Ltd, and the cashier is built around local rails including Swish and Trustly across 10 recorded methods. It carries poker alongside casino, which almost nothing else in this catalogue does. Providers on record are Evolution, NetEnt, Play'n GO, Red Tiger and Quickfire. Two caveats. The welcome offer's mechanics are only partly recorded, so the headline is known but the wagering is not. And generic Malta licence material exists for this brand that contradicts the Swedish record; we do not use it as Swedish regulatory evidence, and neither should you.

bestFor: Players who want catalogue depth above all: 18 providers, the largest of any casino we publish.
Players in Serbia, where the local payment evidence is the most detailed we hold for this brand.
Players in Canada comparing cashier breadth rather than local licensing.
thingsToKnow: There is no Canadian licence here. Gambling is regulated provincially in Canada, and our record establishes no provincial authorisation, so in Canada this is an offshore operator.
We researched a New Zealand profile and deliberately did not publish it: the site's own legal statements there contradict each other, and we would rather show nothing than something unresolved.
The operating company differs by market — Zecure Gaming Ltd in one, Top Slots d.o.o. Beograd in another — so there is no single corporate entity standing behind the brand everywhere.
entries.description: Rizk carries the deepest game catalogue in this collection: 18 providers including Evolution, NetEnt, Play'n GO, Hacksaw Gaming, Nolimit City, Microgaming, IGT and Greentube, across slots, live casino and table games. We publish it for Canada and Serbia, where the Serbian record is the stronger of the two — licensed by the Serbian Ministry of Finance with detailed local payment evidence. Canada is where to be careful: gambling there is regulated province by province, we establish no provincial authorisation, and a Malta licence is not a substitute for one. We also researched a New Zealand profile and held it back, because the site's own legal presentation there contradicts itself and an unresolved contradiction is not something to publish as fact.

entries.description: Skol Casino is the newest White Hat Gaming brand in this catalogue, live since 2021, licensed by the UK Gambling Commission and published for Great Britain, Ireland and Malta. Its pitch is a modern shelf — around 2,500 games from Play'n GO, NetEnt, Games Global, Red Tiger, Blueprint, Push, Evolution and Pragmatic Play — with a lower entry point than its siblings: EUR 10 minimum deposit against EUR 20 at Hello Casino and 21 Prive, on a 100% to EUR 300 plus 100 spins welcome offer. Withdrawal timing on record is one to two days, among the better figures on this platform. Being newest cuts both ways: a current catalogue, but a shorter record to judge it by.

Players prepared to verify how withdrawals are being handled before they deposit — which this brand specifically requires.
thingsToKnow: There are recent complaints about delayed payouts. That is the single reason this brand scores lowest in the group, and it is the thing to check on current player forums before you deposit rather than after you win.
Exact payment and withdrawal facts remain incomplete in our record, so we cannot tell you what timing to expect.
Regional variants of the offer differ, so the terms you see may not be the ones recorded here.
entries.description: Slotnite is a White Hat Gaming brand running since 2019, licensed by the UK Gambling Commission and published for Great Britain, Ireland and Malta. On the catalogue it holds its own — 13 providers including Evolution, NetEnt, Play'n GO, Hacksaw, Nolimit City, Light & Wonder and Quickspin, with 14 payment methods, the joint-widest cashier of the six White Hat brands here — and the welcome offer is recorded with its terms rather than just its headline: 100% to EUR 250 plus 100 spins, EUR 10 minimum. It scores lowest in this group for one reason, and it is not the games. Recent complaints about delayed payouts sit against it. We treat that as a signal rather than proof, because a complaint is one player's account and not a pattern we have verified, but it lowers confidence materially and it is worth an hour of your own reading before you deposit.

bestFor: Players in Italy who want an ADM-licensed site — concession 16026, the Italian state licence, not an offshore one.
Players who want cashier breadth: 15 payment methods on record, the widest of any casino we publish.
Players who want a large catalogue with live casino from Evolution.
thingsToKnow: Italy restricts gambling advertising tightly, so this review is published as information only. You will find no promotional link here, and that is deliberate rather than an oversight.
An Italian welcome offer exists, but its actual mechanics — wagering, minimum deposit, maximum bet — are not established in our record.
Older evidence tied to concession 15230 exists and is stale; the current concession is 16026, and that is the number to check against the ADM register.
entries.description: StarCasino is an Italian casino operated by Azzurri Limited under ADM concession 16026, running since 2012 — a licence from the Italian state regulator rather than an offshore permission, which in Italy is the only kind that counts. It has the widest cashier in this catalogue at 15 recorded payment methods, across a large game shelf with live casino from Evolution alongside Pragmatic Play and Red Tiger. Italy is also the reason this page looks different from the others: Italian law restricts gambling advertising tightly, so we publish this as neutral information with no promotional link and no referral route. An Italian welcome offer is known to exist, but we have not established its terms, so we do not describe it. If you check the ADM register yourself, 16026 is the current concession; older material citing 15230 is out of date.

bestFor: Players who want to know exactly what a bonus costs before taking it — this record has the clearest welcome mechanics in the catalogue.
New Zealand players comparing a documented profile rather than a marketing page.
Live casino players: the recorded catalogue covers live tables alongside slots.
thingsToKnow: The Malta licence is not a New Zealand licence. No New Zealand regulator supervises this operator, and none can help you in a dispute.

New Zealand's Online Casino Gambling Act has been in force since May 2026, and only operators licensed by the DIA from December 2026 may advertise there. Check the current position before acting on anything here.
Method-level cashier limits are incomplete in our record, so deposit and withdrawal ceilings per payment method are unverified.
entries.description: SuperCasino is operated by BML Group Limited under a Malta Gaming Authority licence and profiled here for New Zealand. Its strength is documentation: the welcome offer is recorded more completely than almost anything else in this catalogue — 100% to NZD 1,200 plus 200 free spins at 35x with an NZD 10 minimum deposit, conditions listed and terms linked — which means you can work out what it is worth before you take it rather than after. Five providers are on record including Games Global, Pragmatic Play, Light & Wonder, Kalamba and iSoftBet, across five categories with live casino. The caution is regulatory. A Malta licence is a licence in Malta; it gives a New Zealand player no local regulator to appeal to. New Zealand also brought its Online Casino Gambling Act into force in May 2026, with DIA licensing from December 2026, so the legal position there is actively changing.
